local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local localPlayer = Players.LocalPlayer
local character = localPlayer.Character or localPlayer.CharacterAdded:Wait()
local humanoid = character:WaitForChild("Humanoid")
local animator = humanoid:WaitForChild("Animator")

local samuelStyleEnabled = false
local samuelIdleAnim = animator:LoadAnimation(game.AssetService:GetAsset("rbxassetid://SAMUEL_IDLE"))
local samuelLightAttackAnim = animator:LoadAnimation(game.AssetService:GetAsset("rbxassetid://SAMUEL_LIGHT"))

local currentAttackCombo = {}
local comboTimer = nil
local comboWindow = 0.5 -- Time to input the next attack in a combo

local function switchToSamuelStyle()
	samuelStyleEnabled = true
	samuelIdleAnim:Play(0.1)
	print("Samuel Style Enabled!")
	-- Potentially change movement speed, etc.
end

local function switchToDefaultStyle()
	samuelStyleEnabled = false
	print("Default Style Enabled!")
	-- Revert movement speed, etc.
end

UserInputService.InputBegan:Connect(function(input, gameProcessedEvent)
	if not gameProcessedEvent then
		if input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.Z then -- Example key for switching
			if samuelStyleEnabled then
				switchToDefaultStyle()
			else
				switchToSamuelStyle()
			end
		elseif samuelStyleEnabled then
			if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 then -- Left click for light attack
				playSamuelLightAttack()
			end
		end
	end
end)

local function playSamuelLightAttack()
	if not humanoid:GetPlayingAnimation() then -- Check if not already animating
		samuelLightAttackAnim:Play()
		-- Send a RemoteEvent to the server to handle hit detection and damage
		ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("SamuelLightAttackEvent"):FireServer()
	end
end
